name: byparr
title: Byparr
description: Gets Prowlarr's indexers past 'Verify you are human' pages. It speaks FlareSolverr's protocol and is kept current with a patched Firefox, so it works where FlareSolverr no longer does. In Prowlarr: Settings > Indexers > add a FlareSolverr proxy with the host http://byparr:8191 and a tag, then give that tag to the indexers that need it.

variables.name: PORT_BYPARR
variables.label: Host Port
variables.description: Port on this server (apps on the Docker network use byparr:8191 whatever this is); 8192 by default so it can sit next to FlareSolverr
